name: Grain Distortion Gallery
description: Editorial image gallery rendered in WebGL where images ripple with a grainy noise distortion around the cursor on hover and bend with scroll velocity, with captions beside each image.
contents: Staggered grid of figures, each with an image, a code and a name caption
Fixed full-screen WebGL canvas that draws the images
behavior: Hovering an image eases in a noise-based circular distortion that follows the pointer
Images bend vertically in proportion to scroll velocity and gain noise while scrolling
Source images are hidden in the DOM and drawn as textured meshes synced to scroll position
Resize is debounced and re-measures every image
editableByProps: Images, alt text, captions and number of figures
Background and text colors, image corner radius
Distortion size, noise strength, scroll bend, hover timing and easing
Grid columns, gutter, max width and per-figure placement

needsCodeEdit.change: Change how images bend while scrolling

fixed: Takes over page scrolling with Lenis, so it should be the only smooth scroll on the page
Hides the page scrollbar on html and body while mounted
Draws on one fixed full-screen canvas layered above the page, so it suits a full-page gallery
Hover distortion needs a mouse, on touch only the scroll distortion is active
